skills.name: APK as a ZIP container
skills.description: Understand APK layout at the archive level.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List entries with sizes via process.exec unzip -l on the APK.
2. Identify: classes.dex, resources.arsc, lib/<abi>, assets/, META-INF.
3. Note signatures present (v1 MANIFEST, v2 block) via re.hex.identify probes.
4. Map oversized entries for optimization.
5. Record the structure summary (file.write).

skills.name: Multiple DEX files
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List all classes*.dex entries in the archive.
2. Check main-dex list hints in build files (file.read).
3. re.hex.identify each dex header for version.
4. Map class-per-dex distribution from apktool output (python.run_file count).
5. Summarize the multidex layout.

skills.name: resources.arsc anatomy
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.hex.identify the arsc header.
2. Inspect string pools and package blocks with apktool decode output.
3. Correlate resource ids (0x7f...) with names (file.search public.xml).
4. Note configuration splits (locale/density).
5. Document findings.

skills.name: Binary XML manifest parsing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.hex.identify the binary XML magic.
2. Use re.apk.manifest for the decoded summary.
3. Cross-check with apktool decode for exact strings (file.read AndroidManifest.xml).
4. Note string-pool offsets for surgical edits.
5. Record.

skills.name: v1 (JAR) signing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List META-INF entries (process.exec unzip -l).
2. Inspect MANIFEST.MF digests via extraction + file.read.
3. Sign with re.apk.sign (scheme coverage per tool output).
4. Verify with a benign install.
5. Record which schemes the APK carries.

skills.name: v2/v3 signing blocks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate the signing block marker before the ZIP central directory (re.hex.identify).
2. Sign via re.apk.sign; confirm scheme ids in output.
3. Note min-SDK implications for scheme choice.
4. Verify installer acceptance.
5. Document.

skills.name: ZIP alignment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check unaligned entries via process.exec (zipalign -c if present).
2. Note resources.arsc mmap requirement for targetSdk 30+.
3. Align during rebuild flow (re.apktool.build handles as configured).
4. Verify with re-apk install on device.
5. Record.

skills.name: Split APKs and App Bundles
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List split APKs (base, config.*) from the bundle output.
2. re.apk.manifest each to map split roles.
3. Install via split-install path (process.exec adb install-multiple).
4. For single-APK patching, merge strategy notes (file.write).
5. Record the split map.

skills.name: ABI filtering
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List lib/<abi> folders from the archive.
2. Cross-check device ABI via process.exec getprop ro.product.cpu.abilist.
3. Recommend the minimal set (arm64 + armeabi-v7a typically).
4. Rebuild with filters (gradle.exec ndk abiFilters).
5. Verify the slimmed APK.

skills.name: Version extraction
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apk.manifest for versionCode/versionName.
2. Cross-check BuildConfig in decode output (file.search VERSION).
3. Compare across builds (python.run_file).
4. Record in engagement notes.
5. Flag mismatches.

skills.name: Permission grant mapping
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apk.manifest for uses-permission entries.
2. process.exec dumpsys package <pkg> for granted set.
3. Diff declared vs granted (python.run_file).
4. Flag dangerous grants.
5. Record.

skills.name: Launcher discovery
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apk.manifest: activities with LAUNCHER intent filters.
2. Note application class name.
3. Trace onCreate path in smali (file.search).
4. Record the launch chain.
5. Document.

skills.name: Service inventory
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List services/receivers/providers from re.apk.manifest.
2. Classify: exported, permission-guarded, boot-started.
3. file.search smali for start patterns.
4. Record the component map.
5. Summarize surface.

skills.name: Assets inventory
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List assets/ tree via archive listing.
2. Classify: configs, models, fonts, web content.
3. Inspect configs with file.read after extraction.
4. Flag sensitive-looking files (keys, endpoints) with python.run_file patterns.
5. Report.

skills.name: Resource obfuscation detection
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Compare resource names in public.xml (file.search).
2. Note shortened names (a.b.c patterns).
3. Correlate code references via R constants.
4. Recommend readable builds for debugging.
5. Record.

skills.name: Class count analysis
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Count classes per package from apktool tree (python.run_file).
2. Identify fat packages (SDKs) vs app code.
3. Map third-party SDK signatures (known package names, web.search).
4. Record the SDK inventory.
5. Flag outdated components.

skills.name: Debuggable and backup flags
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apk.manifest for debuggable/allowBackup/networkSecurityConfig.
2. Explain implications for each (research entry, data extraction).
3. Note release hygiene gaps.
4. Recommend fixes to the owner.
5. Record.

skills.name: Network security config review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Extract res/xml/network_security_config if present (apktool decode).
2. file.read the config; note cleartext domains and pin sets.
3. Correlate with observed traffic behavior (http.capture).
4. Recommend tightening.
5. Record.

skills.name: Deep link surface
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Extract scheme/host/pathPrefix from manifest (re.apk.manifest).
2. Match activities handling them (file.search smali).
3. Construct test links; verify routing (androidopenapp).
4. Document the surface.
5. Report.

skills.name: Intent filter matrix
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List all intent-filters from re.apk.manifest (python.run_file parse).
2. Classify: browsable, custom scheme, broadcast actions.
3. Note exported components without filters.
4. Record the matrix.
5. Flag surprises.

skills.name: DEX header deep read
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.hex.identify the dex header region.
2. Parse magic/version/checksum/adler (python.run_file).
3. Relate checksum to file integrity checks.
4. Note header edits needed for manual dex patching.
5. Document.

skills.name: DEX string pool exploration
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Extract strings via re.rabin2 or strings (process.exec).
2. Filter for URLs, keys, paths (python.run_file patterns).
3. Correlate with code sites (file.search smali).
4. Record meaningful strings.
5. Feed analysis.

skills.name: DEX type and proto ids
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Dump types via apktool tree structure (python.run_file classify).
2. Map descriptor strings (Lcom/...;) to classes.
3. Note reflection usage hiding references (file.search forClassName).
4. Record.
5. Report.

skills.name: 64K method limit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Count methods per dex (python.run_file from apktool output).
2. Note proximity to 65536 limits.
3. Recommend multidex config changes (gradle.exec).
4. Verify build.
5. Record.

skills.name: Inline resource values
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate the value in apktool output (file.search).
2. Edit via file.patch in the decoded tree.
3. re.apktool.build; re.apk.sign; re.apk.install.
4. Verify the resource change on device (androidreadscreen).
5. Record.

skills.name: Drawable replacement
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Decode (re.apktool.decode).
2. Replace the drawable file preserving name/format (process.exec cp).
3. Rebuild/sign/install (re.apktool.build + re.apk.sign + re.apk.install).
4. Verify visually (android_screenshot).
5. Record.

skills.name: String localization edits
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find the values-<locale> folder (file.list).
2. Patch the target string (file.patch).
3. Rebuild/sign/install (standard pipeline).
4. Verify in-app text (androidreadscreen).
5. Record.

skills.name: Menu resource edits
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate menu XML (file.search menu folder).
2. Patch items/ids (file.patch).
3. Correlate with code handlers (file.search onOptionsItemSelected).
4. Rebuild via pipeline; verify UI.
5. Record.

skills.name: Theme/color changes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate colors/themes XML (file.search).
2. Patch palette values (file.patch).
3. Rebuild/sign/install (pipeline).
4. Verify visually (android_screenshot).
5. Record.

skills.name: App icon replacement
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Decode; locate mipmap-* densities (file.list).
2. Generate correctly sized replacements (python.run_file PIL if present).
3. Replace files; rebuild/sign/install (pipeline).
4. Verify launcher icon (androidreadscreen).
5. Record.

skills.name: AXML edit validation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. After any res edit, re.apktool.build first (fails fast).
2. Read the exact error line from output.
3. Fix and retry (file.patch).
4. Only then sign/install.
5. Record the loop.

skills.name: Smali edit anchoring
skills.description: Choose safe anchor lines for patches.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read ±20 lines around the target (file.read).
2. Prefer unique instruction sequences as anchors.
3. Note register state at the anchor.
4. Patch minimally (file.patch).
5. Rebuild to validate.

skills.name: Smali register discipline
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Count pN/vN registers in the method (file.read).
2. If adding locals, bump .locals or .registers correctly.
3. Prefer reusing registers over adding.
4. Verify via re.apktool.build (verifier catches mistakes).
5. Record.

skills.name: Invoke kinds semantics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read invoke-virtual vs invoke-static vs invoke-direct sites (file.read).
2. Match receiver/nullability expectations.
3. Patch call targets consistently.
4. Rebuild to verify.
5. Record notes.

skills.name: sget/iput patterns
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify static vs instance field ops (file.read).
2. Match width suffixes (-object, -boolean, -int).
3. Patch consistently with the field type.
4. Rebuild to validate.
5. Record.

skills.name: const width selection
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Use const/4 for small values; const/16, const as needed (file.read context).
2. Never overflow the width.
3. Prefer literal deduction from neighbors.
4. Rebuild to verify.
5. Record.

skills.name: Branch target discipline
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map the method's labels/branches (file.read).
2. Keep branch targets within the method.
3. Prefer restructuring via new labels over renumbering.
4. Rebuild to verify.
5. Record.

skills.name: Try/catch edits
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate .catch directives (file.read).
2. Keep handler ranges consistent with edits.
3. Prefer additive changes.
4. Rebuild to verify.
5. Record.

skills.name: Annotation preservation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Note .annotation blocks around members (file.read).
2. Never split annotation blocks when patching.
3. Preserve runtime-visible annotations for frameworks (Room, Gson).
4. Rebuild to verify.
5. Record.

skills.name: Debug info preservation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Preserve .line directives when patching (file.read).
2. For stack-trace-aligned patches, update or remove consistently.
3. Rebuild to verify.
4. Record preference.

skills.name: Adding methods in smali
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Copy a similar method as template (file.read).
2. Adjust signature/registers/annotations.
3. Insert at class level (file.patch).
4. Rebuild to verify.
5. Record.

skills.name: Adding classes in smali
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Create the .smali file matching package path (file.write).
2. Minimal valid class: .class/.super/constructor.
3. Reference from an existing patch site.
4. Rebuild to verify.
5. Record.

skills.name: String addition safety
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Prefer referencing existing strings where possible (file.search).
2. apktool rebuild handles pool growth; avoid manual hex edits.
3. Rebuild to validate.
4. Verify strings resolve (androidreadscreen).
5. Record.

skills.name: Manifest edit flow
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Patch AndroidManifest.xml in decoded tree (file.patch).
2. Mind package attribute implications (installer conflicts).
3. Rebuild (re.apktool.build) to validate AXML.
4. Sign/install; verify identity (re.apk.manifest).
5. Record.

skills.name: Package rename in an APK
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Patch manifest package (file.patch).
2. Update provider authorities and any hardcoded pkg strings (file.search).
3. Rebuild/sign (pipeline).
4. Install as a separate app; verify (system.app_list).
5. Record the checklist.

skills.name: Provider authority conflicts
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search android:authorities in decoded manifest.
2. Suffix authorities with the new package (file.patch).
3. Update code references to authorities (file.search).
4. Rebuild/install; verify providers work.
5. Record.

skills.name: Provider testing (own app)
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List providers (re.apk.manifest).
2. Query via process.exec content commands.
3. Validate permission guards.
4. Record behaviors.
5. Fix gaps found (file.patch in source).

skills.name: Receiver testing (own app)
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List receivers (re.apk.manifest).
2. Send crafted broadcasts (process.exec am broadcast).
3. Observe handling via logcat.
4. Fix exposure issues in source (file.patch).
5. Record.

skills.name: Activity testing (own app)
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List activities (re.apk.manifest).
2. Start each with expected/edge extras (process.exec am start).
3. Watch for crashes (logcat).
4. Harden source accordingly (file.patch).
5. Record.

skills.name: Service testing (own app)
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List services (re.apk.manifest).
2. start/stop via process.exec am startservice variants.
3. Verify lifecycle in logcat.
4. Harden as needed.
5. Record.
